#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run `ethos doctor` in every git repo directly under ~/Coding/punt-labs/
# and print a per-repo summary followed by the full output.
set -u
root="$HOME/Coding/punt-labs"
out="$root/ethos/.tmp/doctor-all"
mkdir -p "$out"
printf '%-24s %-6s %4s %4s %4s\n' REPO EXIT PASS WARN FAIL
for d in "$root" "$root"/*/; do
  d="${d%/}"
  [ -e "$d/.git" ] || continue
  name="$(basename "$d")"
  [ "$d" = "$root" ] && name="punt-labs (workspace)"
  log="$out/${name%% *}.txt"
  (cd "$d" && timeout 120 ethos doctor) >"$log" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  p=$(grep -c ' PASS ' "$log")
  w=$(grep -c ' WARN ' "$log")
  f=$(grep -c ' FAIL ' "$log")
  printf '%-24s %-6s %4s %4s %4s\n' "$name" "$rc" "$p" "$w" "$f"
done
